title: Delete the 4 unused SCREENS_*_ARCHIVED dead-code arrays from tool/vision_find_pass.js
why: These 4 top-level consts (lines 11-87, roughly a third of the file) are grepped nowhere else in the file — only the separate `SCREENS` const at line 89 feeds the actual orchestration loop at line 224. Git history already preserves prior rounds' screen lists, so keeping ~180 lines of never-executed array literals in the live script is pure clutter that makes the file 3x longer than its live logic and risks a future editor mistaking one of the ARCHIVED arrays for the active one.
recommendation: Delete SCREENS_FR1_ARCHIVED, SCREENS_E2E_R1_ARCHIVED, SCREENS_E2E_R2_ARCHIVED, and SCREENS_E2E_R3_ARCHIVED; rely on git log/blame for historical reference instead of committed dead arrays.
acceptance_criteria: None of SCREENS_FR1_ARCHIVED / SCREENS_E2E_R1_ARCHIVED / SCREENS_E2E_R2_ARCHIVED / SCREENS_E2E_R3_ARCHIVED remain defined in the file.

corrections: The 'why' overstates magnitude: dead span is ~77 lines (33% of file, matching its own 'roughly a third' claim), not the '~180 lines'/'3x longer than its live logic' also asserted in the same paragraph — internally inconsistent but doesn't change the core dead-code verdict.
